title: Synthetic hobby causes for medium realistic v2
description: Campaign-local synthetic statements for testing public-goods projects. They are not accepted real Conceptspace seed content.
notes: Synthetic testnet campaign only; do not publish through the real seed-content pipeline.

statements.text: I want free, reusable guitar lessons that beginners can learn from at their own pace.
I want free interactive music theory tools that let learners hear the ideas they are studying.
I want freely available music lessons made with and for learners in Grey County, Ontario.
I want free, clearly documented guides to diagnosing and repairing common car problems safely.
I want practical car repair teaching materials that learners and community workshops can reuse.
I want accessible car repair knowledge for people in Grey County, Ontario, where a broken car can mean losing a way to get around.
I want freely available gluten-free recipes that have been tested and clearly explain substitutions and cross-contact precautions.
I want practical gluten-free recipes using affordable ingredients that ordinary grocery stores carry.
I want an open collection of gluten-free recipes that makes good use of food grown in Grey County, Ontario.
I want open-source tools and servers that keep small video game communities running.
I want reusable accessibility tools and public testing results that help more people play video games.
I want lawful tools and documentation that help preserve access to older video games.
I want a free, reusable sheet for scoping, pricing, and doing small contracting jobs safely.
I want independent contractors to be able to share expensive tools, with the schedule and upkeep published.
I want public notes on how older buildings in Grey County, Ontario, were actually built, so the next job does not start from a hole in the wall.
I want free chord charts, in playable keys, for the songs small congregations actually sing.
I want practice tracks so a substitute musician can prepare when the regular player is away.
I want a public trial of a work-rest routine, including the result if it fails, so other people can judge it.
I want a quiet work block that people who work alone can share, with a public record of whether it stayed quiet.
